verdict.rationale: Context.dev is a web and document extraction API, so extracting large tables within processing limits is a fair question for it. However, the evidence never mentions table-aware or intelligent chunking. Spreadsheet-to-Markdown parsing, 25K-page batch crawling, and partial-result timeout handling are adjacent features, not chunked extraction of very large tables.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can extract data from very large tables using intelligent chunking so it fits within processing limits
